scope: Original mapped-memory msync/writeback: common source/solo ABI and range capture, actual mapped-backing admission, chained native persistence, accepted completion/cancellation, original inode deduplication and final resource lifetime.

architecture.import_: Source/solo share alignment/flag/length validation and original Memory/View range selection. All mappings are checked before callback effects. Owned original providers survive unmap/replacement and wake-target handoff; no guest pointer or numeric FD is reimported at completion.
architecture.selection: The cold snapshot backing index retains only original MAP_SHARED providers requiring writeback. Anonymous/imported/shared-zero/no-op private-host providers avoid jobs, page reads and physical charges. No field/lookup is added to CPU frames or byte translations.
architecture.execution: Existing FileLayouts admission quiesces actual readers of one original backing and publishes dirty/copied bytes. HostFileTask chains persistence on the existing disk pool, releasing each ticket before accepting the next. Waiting returns the CPU slot; unrelated mms keep their Views.
architecture.identity: FileMapping sync deduplication uses the existing globally unique immutable original inode identity, not a guest inode number local to a filesystem. It adds no identity counter or lock.
architecture.completion: Existing FileResult/FilePending retain original completion across queue/cohort handoff. Errors stop the unattempted suffix. Weak layout-queue references avoid owner/request cycles. Callback unwind, closed pools and dropped owners release admissions/resources and complete the accepted wait.
architecture.semantics: Existing flag behavior is retained: admitted supported flags use the same original synchronization body. This does not newly implement lazy MS_ASYNC, page invalidation or mlock semantics. Custom providers lacking real original layout admission defer before effects; solo dispatch remains on its original caller.
